subject.title: Reconnect supervisor hangs on zombie WSS — no event/log emitted, requires manual restart

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a bounded Slack Socket Mode transport-idle recovery policy, and if so what transport signals and timeout policy are acceptable for quiet production workspaces?
rationale: The bug is well-supported, but the false-positive boundary and recovery threshold intentionally change channel availability behavior and require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Adopt transport-idle recovery
options.body: Review and repair the linked PR so owned transport signals reset a bounded waiter while ordinary app-event silence remains healthy.

options.title: Choose a different recovery boundary
options.body: Specify a Slack-owned alternative such as a provider restart policy or another verified liveness source before accepting implementation work.

recommendation.title: Adopt transport-idle recovery
recommendation.body: Review and repair the linked PR so owned transport signals reset a bounded waiter while ordinary app-event silence remains healthy.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue opener explicitly routed the report to this person, making them the best available review-routing candidate in the supplied evidence.
